decided_by: Louwrens, 2026-08-06 — K53-48, "Die 41 keuses AFR.docx" (his choice marked by yellow highlight; his own comment: "Yellow is the correct translation")
summary: Deletes the remaining 41 ui_translations override rows after Louwrens ruled on every one of them. His answers were applied to messages/{af,en}.json FIRST (28 strings changed), so each delete restores a default that is now identical to, or explicitly chosen over, the row it removes. Split: 27 A (keep his wording), 13 B (our alternative), 1 C (new wording he wrote for exam.sectionBrief). After this the ui_translations table is empty and messages/*.json is once again the only source of truth for UI copy — which is the whole point of AP-01. AP-02 remains outstanding: nothing yet prevents a future admin edit from silently shadowing a later code change.
order_of_operations: messages/*.json committed and DEPLOYED before these deletes run. Deleting first would serve the pre-review machine draft on /af for the 28 changed strings until the deploy landed.
